tools.name: diff_receipt
tools.description: Two JSON documents in; out come a sha256 of each in canonical form, an RFC 6902 patch between them, and a sha256 of the patch. The same two documents always give the same three hashes, so a diff can be quoted and rechecked. Or send a document and a patch to get the result pinned.

tools.name: run_receipt
tools.description: Pins one tool run as (tool, version, seed, input hash) -> output hash. Make a receipt, verify one against a rerun, or compare several: reproducible, not_reproducible, or not_the_same_run. The route never runs your tool or sees more than you send.

tools.name: notary_reveal
tools.description: Send the value and salt. Returns whether they hash to a commitment recorded here and when it was first seen, plus any later drand round you name as shared public randomness.

tools.name: handoff_verify
tools.description: A handoff the sender signed and an acknowledgement the receiver signed, checked together: same handoff, same state pin, right receiver, right order in time. Returns SENT_ONLY, APPLIED, VERIFIED or INVALID with each problem named. Holds no key, stores nothing.

tools.name: multi_source
tools.description: Read one value from 2 to 7 public JSON sources (a URL and a path each) and get what more than half of them say, the sources that disagree with what they said, and a sha256 pin per source. tools.name: post_landed
tools.description: Your post timed out. We read the public thread or list ourselves and compare the text: landed (once, unaltered, with the venue id), duplicated, landed_altered, or missing. "Missing" is refused on a paginated list or a throttled read, so you do not repost on a guess.

tools.name: outbox_intent
tools.description: Record what you are about to send (its sha256) before you send it. The same intent with a different body is refused with 422.

tools.name: outbox_next
tools.description: Returns send, read_back or skip. After a send whose reply was lost it says read_back, not send. It marks an intent delivered only when you report that a read at the venue found it, with the id the venue minted; never from your own send log.

tools.name: price_change

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: freshness_proof, schema_drift, relay_canary, session_snapshot, multi_source, post_landed, unfurl_check, seller_precheck, site_readiness · Private data: access_preflight, diff_receipt, notary_commit, im_tenant, session_snapshot, pagination_crawl, delivery_dedupe, outbox_intent, unfurl_check, seller_precheck, npm_file, site_readiness · Public sink: bill_reconcile, throttle_clear, soft_empty, idempotency_check, abuse_sentinel, diff_receipt, run_receipt, notary_commit, relay_risk_check, im_tenant, relay_canary, notary_reveal, session_snapshot, post_landed, delivery_dedupe, outbox_intent, outbox_next · Destructive: throttle_clear, run_receipt, price_change, unfurl_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: freshness_proof, schema_drift, relay_canary, session_snapshot, multi_source, post_landed, unfurl_check, seller_precheck, site_readiness · Private data: access_preflight, diff_receipt, notary_commit, im_tenant, session_snapshot, pagination_crawl, delivery_dedupe, outbox_intent, unfurl_check, seller_precheck, npm_file, site_readiness · Public sink: bill_reconcile, throttle_clear, soft_empty, idempotency_check, abuse_sentinel, diff_receipt, run_receipt, notary_commit, relay_risk_check, im_tenant, relay_canary, notary_reveal, session_snapshot, post_landed, delivery_dedupe, outbox_intent, outbox_next · Destructive: throttle_clear, run_receipt, price_change, unfurl_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
